title: A repo's seam registry
description: Each seam a repo has, with its provider, consumers, contract and test world. It holds no practice status or other tool's state.

id.description: <kind>:<provider>/<name>, where provider is _ for a seam with no single owner.

name.description: A component, or a vendor: the name Pact uses for the pacticipant, where Pact is used.

external.description: Outside the system, such as a vendor.

inRepo.description: Its code is in this repo.

was.description: Ids the seam had before it was renamed.

provider.description: Whoever owns the exchange surface, or null for a seam with no single owner.

location.description: A path in the repo, or a URL.

test.description: The contract test: a path, or a name.

tier.description: The test policy's tier it runs in, such as gate.

tool.description: The tool that runs it, such as Pact or go test.

rejection.description: A candidate the team decided isn't a seam, so it isn't proposed again.

signal.description: The kind of evidence that proposed it.

file.description: The evidence's file, without its line, which moves.
